limitations: One shared Mac and one Colima VM; three Cellar containers each with one CPU, 3 GiB and no swap, plus separate RustFS resources. Unrelated Colima profiles remain active and were not mutated.

The original 20-second measurement and numeric SLOs are unchanged. One-second backend pauses are allowed to miss traffic targets; correctness/recovery checks do not convert those misses into performance acceptance.
Process freeze does not establish crash, packet-loss, power-loss, disk-loss, Amazon S3 or independent-zone resilience. Ambiguous outcomes refuse qualification and are not retried with new IDs.
The four adapters retain distinct authority, local-copy, read and receipt contracts. Shared fault timing and SQL transitions do not establish equivalence.
Steady state, causal latency, instrumentation overhead, sustained S3 acceptance and Q1 capacity remain open. MR-13 operating, MR-15 release, MR-16 scale and MR-17 federation gates remain incomplete.
Exact owned containers are stopped, their empty networks removed and volumes retained. Only the dedicated profile was controlled and it is stopped.

findings.acknowledgement_windows: All four outage scenarios have two verified paused windows. Raft S3 and bucket acknowledge zero of six new observed commands during those holds; Quorum acknowledges ten of ten, and Fleet six of six, under their distinct policies.
findings.traffic: All four healthy controls and the Quorum outage meet the original short-run traffic objectives. S3, bucket and Fleet outages miss them. No threshold changed.
findings.fleet_scope: The two delayed owner queries overlap the first pause; this is correlation, not a proven causal sub-operation. All 93 measured Fleet output-proof completions use Fleet and zero use bucket; no per-command proof is inferred from the aggregate.
findings.resources: All 32 experiment containers stopped with exit code zero and no OOM. Eight exact empty networks were removed; all volumes and stopped containers remain.
findings.verification: All eight independent analyzers pass again after hashed capsule extraction. Both S3-versus-bucket comparisons refuse an equivalent-contract ratio.
